lens: Practical continuity from source capture to reviewed relationship state

findings.observation: A missing save receipt can fragment one contact-creation intent into two people. The known partial-success path is improved, but an unknown first result remains an active gate.
findings.user_impact: The operator must reconstruct what saved and which Person owns the evidence, adding work and risking incorrect follow-up.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the frozen intent explicitly before allowing corrections to become a new intent.
findings.verification: After an interrupted save, the user reaches one canonical Person with the expected note and clue, without duplicate creation.

findings.observation: Sources, relationship brief and Person Memory now have clearer labels, but successful imported source does not by itself prove a completed Memory-review loop. The attempted live Memory proposal failed and stayed retryable.
findings.evidence: README.md revised browser acceptance and coverage; Person ea7363d2-1f21-4686-bdbb-03210e7736dd in the isolated Lab; Session 5bc26235-ff8f-43fb-b86d-dcc315cc1802.
findings.user_impact: The user can inspect the source yet still lacks proof that a reviewed statement is saved, corrected and available from the Person destination.
findings.recommendation: Finish the real model proposal, per-item confirmation, destination reload and correction/undo loop; retain failure evidence separately.
findings.verification: A synthetic grounded proposal becomes exactly the selected accepted Memory item and reloads at the correct Person; correction/undo preserve provenance.

strengths: Real creation reaches its authenticated destination and retains one note plus one confirmed clue.
Source conflict preserves editable input and requires a fresh choice.
Conversation stop/edit/reload/continue and Time create/edit/delete lifecycle were exercised.
missing_evidence: Representative recruiter task trials and time-to-completion comparisons.
Successful live Memory-review lifecycle in this audit.
Cross-device/day recovery and exact-runtime prioritization acceptance.
vetoes: Unknown-save recovery can duplicate a Person
open_questions: Can a first-time operator explain source, brief and accepted Memory without visiting all three surfaces?
